sprites.name: Water
sprites.desc: A bubbly aquatic Sprite that restores shields for you and nearby squadmates while you are in water.

sprites.name: Earth
sprites.desc: A mossy, rock-and-tree Sprite that increases the chance of extra rare items from chests.

sprites.name: Fire
sprites.desc: A fiery Sprite that creates a damaging burst after you deal enough damage to an enemy.

sprites.name: Fishy
sprites.desc: An aquatic Fishstick-themed Sprite that boosts swimming speed and briefly speeds you up when damaged.

sprites.name: Air
sprites.desc: A wind Sprite that improves sprint speed and jump height and negates fall damage.

sprites.name: Ghost
sprites.desc: A spectral utility Sprite that briefly cloaks its owner after reloading.

sprites.name: Zero Point
sprites.desc: A reality-energy Sprite that creates a Shield Bubble Jr. when you use a healing item on yourself.

sprites.name: Seven
sprites.desc: A Seven-themed Sprite that reveals enemy foot trails to your squad.

sprites.name: King
sprites.desc: A crowned Sprite that increases the damage dealt by your Pickaxe.

sprites.name: Boss
sprites.desc: A powerful companion that boosts its owner's maximum Health and Shield.

sprites.name: Punk
sprites.desc: A rebellious Sprite that occasionally grants an unlimited-ammo buff.

sprites.name: Dream
sprites.desc: A sleepy Sprite that grants a random item at each level and showers Legendary loot at max level.

sprites.name: Aura
sprites.desc: An energetic Sprite that grants a Shock Rock charge after you deal enough damage.

sprites.name: Striker
sprites.desc: A soccer-themed Sprite that triggers Overdrive when you mantle or hurdle.

sprites.name: Duck
sprites.desc: A duck-shaped Sprite that replenishes shields while its owner Emotes or Jams.

sprites.name: Grim Reaper
sprites.desc: A reaper-themed Sprite that marks players who damage you and reveals them on the map.

sprites.name: Demon
sprites.desc: A red demon Sprite that siphons some Health and Shield when you eliminate an opponent.

sprites.name: Batman
sprites.desc: A Batman-themed Sprite that launches you airborne and lets you deploy the Bat Cape to glide.

sprites.name: Burnt Peanut
sprites.desc: An unusual goopy Sprite with a chance to drop extra loot, sometimes Mythic, after eliminations.

sprites.name: Vini Jr.
sprites.desc: A Vini Jr.-themed Sprite whose sprint powers a destructive slide; slide-kicks boost fire rate and reload speed.

sprites.name: Pollo
sprites.desc: A Pollo-themed Sprite that slowly restores Shield to you and nearby squadmates after an elimination.
